phase_name: Extend the probe's test suite with reachability-tier fixtures

objectives.description: Re-read harness helpers, extend header fixture inventory
Fixture K: not_reachable tier + interpretation sentence assertion
Mutation 3: environ cross-check deletion, targeted controls

approaches_tried.approach: Capture start_fake_lean_lsp_server's PID via $(...) command substitution, echoing the pid from inside the function
approaches_tried.reason: Classic bash gotcha: the backgrounded (300s-sleeping) child inherits the subshell's stdout fd (the one $(...) is reading from to capture output), so the command substitution hangs until that 300s sleep finishes, since it waits for ALL holders of the pipe to close it, not just the function's own echo. Fixed two ways: (1) explicitly redirect the backgrounded script's own stdout/stderr to /dev/null so it never holds the capture pipe open, and (2) switched callers off $(...) entirely, having the function set a global FAKE_LAST_PID instead -- this also fixes a second, independent bug: a function called via $(...) runs in a subshell, so its FAKE_SERVER_PIDS array append was being silently discarded once the subshell exited, leaving the trap EXIT cleanup's array empty for J/L.

approaches_tried.approach: Mutation 3 K-control assuming 'no candidate row exists' once the environ check is deleted
approaches_tried.reason: False on two counts in practice: (a) this dev machine has a genuine, long-lived, ambient lean-lsp-mcp process running (this very coding session's own MCP server), visible system-wide via ps, which the loosened (no-environ-check) mutated probe promotes to 'reachable' for ANY project queried; (b) fixtures J's and L's own deliberately-started fake servers are also still alive at the point K's mutation-3 check runs (killed only at file-exit), and the mutated probe treats either as a valid candidate for K's project too. Fixed by (a) adding an isolated `ps` stub (make_isolated_ps_stub) that filters the real ps output down to rows under $WORKDIR only, with the filter pattern passed via an environment variable rather than a literal argv substring so the filter's OWN awk process can't self-match the pattern it's filtering for, and (b) explicitly killing FAKE_PID_J and FAKE_PID_L (after their own L/J mutation assertions run, which need them alive) before running K's mutation-3 check.
